'Create 3 Toughness tokens. Go again.' Revered Action (GEM).

GO AGAIN NOT AUTHORED: unconditional printed keyword (printed_keywords carries GoAgain), so it fires from the card DB keywords field when the card layer resolves - re-authoring it would be a defect. Contrast hold_firm.json, where the same trailing text HAD to be authored because that card's ability is an equipment ACTIVATION the DB keyword never covers; Humble Entrance is a played action card, the case the DB keyword handles.

CREATE_TOKEN (effect_types.py:1942-2013) reads token/count|amount/player - amount 3, default SELF control, template-derived destination. Spelling copied from .drafts/hold_firm.json (identical clause). json/tokens/toughness.json exists, so resolution cannot raise MissingCardImplementation.

Triage list named GO_AGAIN as a primitive; deliberately not followed for the reason above.
